description.value: Mountain View Motel is a pet-friendly motel on Highway 16 (Yellowhead Highway) in Smithers, BC, offering a range of room types from bachelor suites to two-bedroom units, many with kitchenettes and in-room appliances. It caters to both short-term and extended stays, which makes it a practical option for touring cyclists spending time in the Smithers area. Rooms come with mountain views, and the property provides free parking for guests.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully accessible and confirms the motel is a real, operating property in Smithers, BC on Highway 16 E (= Yellowhead Highway). Phone, email, and address all match OSM. Wi-Fi is explicitly confirmed ('Our rooms come equipped with free Wi-Fi'). No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, e-bike charging, or any other cycling-specific amenity anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM address field uses 'Yellowhead Highway' while the website uses 'Highway 16 E'; these are the same road but the website provides the fuller civic address including city and postal code, which has been used here.
Community field in OSM data is 'Unknown / North Coast & Haida Gwaii' but Smithers is in the Bulkley-Nechako region — may warrant a community classification correction.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating motel in Smithers, BC with a live website and confirmed contact details — straightforward inclusion for touring cyclists on the Yellowhead corridor.
